title: First hour
summary: Twenty tiny C tasks. Fill in ???, press Run, and keep going.

lessons.title: Hello
lessons.goal: Print hello from lilC. Replace ??? in printf, then press RUN.

lessons.title: Variables
lessons.goal: A variable holds a number. Replace ??? with a year, then RUN.

lessons.title: If
lessons.goal: C can choose. Fill in the condition so 28 prints warm.

lessons.title: Loop
lessons.goal: Loops repeat work. Fill in the bound so the program prints 1 through 5.

lessons.title: Array
lessons.goal: An array is a list. Add the values so the program prints 20.

lessons.title: Function
lessons.goal: A function names a calculation. Make twice return n times 2.

lessons.title: Add
lessons.goal: C can do math. Add 5 to n so the program prints 15.

lessons.title: Equals
lessons.goal: Use == to compare. Fill in 4 so the program prints match.

lessons.title: While
lessons.goal: A while loop repeats while a test is true. Count down 3, 2, 1.

lessons.title: Remainder
lessons.goal: % is leftover after divide. Fill in 2 so 8 prints even.

lessons.title: And
lessons.goal: && means both tests. Fill in 20 so 12 prints in.

lessons.title: Index
lessons.goal: The first slot is 0. Print the value at index 1, which is 9.

lessons.title: Count
lessons.goal: Count how many values are greater than 4. The program should print 2.

lessons.title: Biggest
lessons.goal: Walk the list and keep the largest value. Print 9.

lessons.title: Nested
lessons.goal: A loop inside a loop. Fill in 2 so the program prints 11 12 21 22.

lessons.title: Swap
lessons.goal: Trade two values using a spare. Print 2 then 1.

lessons.title: Sum
lessons.goal: A function can take two inputs. Make sum return a plus b.

lessons.title: Opposite
lessons.goal: If n is negative, return the positive. opposite(-4) should print 4.

lessons.title: Find
lessons.goal: Search the list for 7. Print its index, 1.

lessons.title: Copy
lessons.goal: Copy each value into a second list. Print 4 9 1.
